title: Tentative End Semester Examination Date Sheet · November–December 2026

source.title: Tentative Date Sheet for Regular End Semester Examinations – November 2026
source.provenance: Published as a public Google Sheet linked from the official GNDEC ERP noticeboard. Tabs are department/programme datesheets. The sheet prints session windows but not rooms, seats, or reporting times; no such facts are inferred.
